name: Columbus
source:
"No matter how badly you lose, I'll let you keep your pants on."

Based on Christopher Columbus, who was an Italian explorer, navigator and colonizer. Under the auspices of the Catholic Monarchs of Spain, he completed four voyages across the Atlantic Ocean. Those voyages and his efforts to establish permanent settlements on the island of Hispaniola initiated the European colonization of the New World.

Hailing from Europe, Columbus is now the hero in charge of the USA. She is old acquaintances with the EU heroes [url=/c5193]Magellan[/url] and [url=/c5165]Cook[/url]. Composed and calculating, she does not take interest in anything that doesn't bring her profit.

On the other hand, she shows no hesitation with involving herself in shady deals if she can profit from it. Her hobby is gambling. Although she is frequently exasperated by [url=/c5185]Billy's[/url] idiocy, she still holds her dear.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char08a]English official site[/url]]
